top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards an original, mature physiology discovery chain, from incretin physiology (Holst) and proglucagon and receptor biology (Drucker) to the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov), confirmed by large outcome trials in diabetes, obesity and cardiorenal disease. The three-person allocation and the physiology-focused citation are defensible, though Mojsov's priority versus Habener and the omission of Knudsen remain real costs. These costs do not justify awarding nothing, so no award ranks last.
